title: Gas Station
description: There are n gas stations along a circular route, where gas[i] is the amount of gas at station i, and cost[i] is the gas needed to travel from station i to station i+1. Return the starting station index if you can travel around the circuit once, otherwise return -1. It is guaranteed that there is at most one solution.
